title: What to expect from Maximum Upload Size

question.author: member_228
question.body: I am checking my CloudBox setup. Which documented details matter for maximum upload size?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Storage Limits documentation says: The 20 GB desktop limit was introduced in CloudBox 2.0 (September 2023); earlier versions were limited to 5 GB. Uploads that exceed the limit fail with the error "File too large". You can upload files up to 20 GB in size through the desktop and mobile clients, and through the API. The web app has a separate, smaller limit: files uploaded through a browser are capped at 2 GB. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
